530601.name: Ersatz Wormhole
530601.description: Fires lasers from four pseudo-wormholes, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The wormholes can be destroyed.

530605.name: Summon Wormhole
530605.description: Opens a wormhole and summons Raptures. The summoned Raptures will generate a code barrier and then proceed to fire a restraining laser and self-destruct. Any Nikkes who are hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

530606.name: Summon Asteroids
530606.description: Opens multiple wormholes and summons asteroids. Any Nikkes who are hit will have their ATK reduced. This effect can stack. The asteroids can be intercepted.

530607.name: Wormhole Laser
530607.description:
Fires powerful lasers from the wormhole at all Nikkes, dealing damage.
Gatekeeper generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Wormhole Laser. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

530608.name: Interstellar Missile
530608.description:
Summons interstellar missiles, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while summoning missiles. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.
The missiles can be intercepted.

530609.name: Miniature Solar Generator
530609.description:
Creates a portal into subspace and summons a miniature sun.
The portal must be closed via Special Interruption.
If the opening is not closed, it deals damage to all Nikkes.

530615.name: Summon Wormhole
530615.description:
Opens a wormhole above itself to summon meteors before launching them at all Nikkes, dealing damage and temporarily immobilizing them.
Gatekeeper generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while summoning meteors. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.
